title: Y-stream: aerodynamic textile tail for semi-trailers, up to 10 % less fuel
description: Y-stream is a patented textile aerodynamic device for semi-trailers that inflates with the airflow: −15 % drag, up to −10 % fuel. Validated in the wind tunnel, looking for industrial partners and investors to go to scale 1.
ogTitle: Y-stream: trucks are cubes on wheels. We make them slip through the air.
keywords: truck aerodynamics, semi-trailer drag reduction, boat tail, fuel saving trucks, aerodynamic device HGV, ease lab
